title: Senior ML Inference & Performance Engineer - Model Optimization, High Throughput & Production Serving
description:
We have several ML/AI models that are already trained and need to be deployed in a highly optimized, production-grade inference environment.

We are looking for an experienced ML Inference / Performance Engineer who can take models from the current state to a reliable production serving stack with:
Very low inference latency
High throughput
Efficient GPU/CPU utilization
Horizontal scaling
Robust observability and logging
Production-grade reliability
Efficient infrastructure and GPU cost

This is not a simple model-serving or DevOps deployment task. We are looking for someone who understands inference performance at the model, runtime, kernel, serving, and infrastructure levels.

What You Will Work On

1. Model Inference Optimization
Profile and optimize our existing models for production inference. Depending on the model, this may include:
FP32 → FP16/BF16/FP8/INT8/INT4 optimization where appropriate
Quantization and accuracy/performance trade-offs
Torch compilation / graph optimization
ONNX / TensorRT / TensorRT-LLM / ONNX Runtime optimization where applicable
Operator fusion
Kernel optimization
Memory optimization
GPU memory management
CPU optimization where applicable
Reducing unnecessary data movement and host-device transfers
Optimizing preprocessing and postprocessing
Optimizing tokenization, decoding, feature extraction, etc.
Dynamic/static batching
Continuous/in-flight batching where applicable
Concurrency optimization
Efficient model loading and warm-up
Model parallelism / pipeline strategies where required
We expect you to identify bottlenecks using profiling and benchmarking, rather than relying on assumptions.

Expected Deliverables
By the end of the engagement, we expect:
Optimized inference implementation for our models.
Production-ready inference APIs/services.
Benchmarking and load-testing framework.
Before/after performance report.
Recommended GPU/runtime configuration.
Batching/concurrency configuration.
Logging and observability implementation.
Grafana/monitoring dashboards or equivalent.
Autoscaling configuration.
Production deployment configuration.
Failure handling and reliability improvements.
Infrastructure/cost optimization recommendations.
Clear technical documentation for operating and maintaining the system.

Required Experience
We are looking for someone with strong practical experience in:
ML inference optimization; GPU performance engineering; PyTorch; CUDA; Model serving; High-throughput inference; Distributed systems; Performance profiling; Load testing; Production monitoring; Autoscaling; Linux; Docker

Strong experience with several of the following is preferred:
NVIDIA Triton; vLLM; TensorRT; TensorRT-LLM; ONNX Runtime; CUDA profiling; Nsight Systems / Nsight Compute; Kubernetes; Prometheus; Grafana; OpenTelemetry; NVIDIA DCGM; AWS / GCP GPU infrastructure
